_note: Band 5 → 7 → 9 (docs/specs/band-upgrade.md): MỘT ý nâng 3 bậc. Câu mẫu tự viết theo mô tả band IELTS công khai (Lexical Resource / Grammatical Range / Coherence & Cohesion / Task Response); mỗi bậc nêu 1 lý do (reasons) ≤ 6 từ. `mark` = cụm được nâng, phải nằm trong câu. langs = hook + mẹo bản địa 14 ngôn ngữ (tầng i18n-fixed, en = gốc; xưng hô de = Sie, fr = vous, es = tú), kiểm bằng band-l1-qa.mjs.

steps.text: Technology is good for people.
Technology is beneficial because it eases communication.
Technology transforms communication, though it can weaken personal ties.
steps.mark: though it can weaken personal ties

steps.text: Exercise is good for your health.
Regular exercise improves physical and mental health.
Exercise strengthens the body and, equally, steadies the mind.
Big cities have many problems.
Large cities face serious problems such as pollution.
Large cities face serious problems, yet they remain hubs of opportunity.
steps.mark: yet they remain hubs of opportunity

steps.text: I think money is very important.
I believe money matters because it gives people security.
Money matters, though it rarely buys lasting satisfaction.
steps.mark: though it rarely buys lasting satisfaction

steps.text: Travel is fun and you learn things.
Travelling is enjoyable and broadens your horizons.
Travel broadens the mind precisely because it unsettles assumptions.
We must protect the environment.
Governments should take action to protect the planet.
Governments must act now, otherwise future generations will pay.
A good job is important.
A rewarding job gives people a sense of purpose.
A rewarding job matters less for its salary than for the purpose it provides.
steps.mark: less for its salary than for the purpose it provides

steps.text: Fast food is bad for health.
Fast food is harmful because it contains too much sugar.
Fast food is harmful, but banning it would be an overreaction.
steps.mark: but banning it would be an overreaction

steps.text: Many people use social media.
Social media is an essential part of daily life.
steps.mark: an essential part of daily life

steps.text: Social media is so essential that few imagine life without it.
steps.mark: so essential that few imagine life without it

steps.text: Climate change is a big problem.
Climate change is a pressing issue that affects everyone.
Climate change is a pressing issue whose consequences no country can escape.
steps.mark: whose consequences no country can escape

steps.text: Working in a team is good.
Working in a team is advantageous because ideas are shared.
Teamwork pays off when people combine their strengths rather than compete.
steps.mark: pays off when people combine their strengths rather than compete

steps.text: Sleep is very important for students.
Adequate sleep is vital for students’ concentration.
Adequate sleep is vital, since tired students rarely concentrate or remember much.
steps.mark: since tired students rarely concentrate or remember much

steps.text: Reading books is useful.
Reading is rewarding because it expands your vocabulary.
Reading widely expands vocabulary and sharpens thinking.
Cities have too many cars.
Heavy traffic is a major cause of pollution.
Heavy traffic causes pollution, so public transport deserves investment.
